description: Four terminal coding agents herdr runs, through their npm names: three by npm -g, Oh My Pi by bun install -g.
why: Devin CLI and Oh My Pi are installed and not run, so their package is the only witness and removing it from the catalog turns must_find red; forbid_evidence holds ~/.omp absent, so a release that starts writing it on install fails here rather than adding a second witness unseen. MastraCode writes no top-level directory, so its npm row is its only witness. Command Code has two, its package and ~/.commandcode, so must_contain names both. Oh My Pi is a fork of Pi and bun hoists its dependencies beside it, so pi and openclaw (built on Pi's libraries) are forbidden; windsurf because its cask is devin-desktop; claude-code and codex-cli because top-level home directories are their routes too.
known_gaps: MastraCode's ~/.mastracode, where herdr's integration writes its hook, is not created by --version or -p and is unread.
Command Code's and Devin CLI's npm packages on Windows, and Devin CLI's winget package, are not exercised.
